lead: Meeting assistants and parallel coding tools expand the places AI can work, while four-bit research exposes the numerical compromises behind efficiency. Aviation coverage requires separating advisory deployment from outage attribution, and several financial and product-data claims remain available only as excerpts.

sections.title: From a meeting to a running work session
sections.intro: Shared meeting context and parallel coding expose different permission and coordination boundaries.

sections.title: Four-bit efficiency is a numerical tradeoff
sections.intro: Training precision and local inference both depend on the exact comparison.

sections.title: Advisory AI is not an incident root cause
sections.intro: Separate the September plan, November rollout and developer response to the ground stop.

sections.title: Data access and financing remain contested
sections.intro: User observations, blocked reporting and corporate plans have different evidence limits.

sections.title: A forecast indexed again
sections.intro: The same research-acceleration essay remains a conditional forecast.
